name: Petrify
description: Petrify device discovery, playback handoff and listening-party relay.
overview: Runs the bundled Petrify relay with Jellyfin, with validated network and party timing settings and an optional browser health check.

versions.changelog: Relay 1.2.6: adds playback protocol 8 for acknowledged cross-device handoffs, fresh source playback snapshots and reliable source stopping; retains queue voting, management, independent voting, party reactions and relay health diagnostics.
